leverage.exposure: No leverage is open. The balance is positive and no offers are outstanding, so nothing has to be unwound before the lock and there is no path by which this matchday scores zero. That is the single most valuable feature of the current position and every recommendation this run is shaped to preserve it. The one structure that was costed and refused would have opened exactly that exposure: its auction resolves under four hours before the lock, the funding sale can only follow the purchase, and being away for that window would have forfeited the entire matchday to chase a marginal gain. Roughly twelve hundred fielded points were not worth risking for a few dozen.

binding_gap: The weakest fielded slot on the season's numbers is the young Elversberg centre-back, and the honest answer is that it cannot be fixed. Funding a replacement out of him yields barely more than pocket money once his own value is added to the cash in hand, and there is no defender on the board with any scoring record at all inside that figure. Every defender who would actually improve the slot costs several times it. The gap is real, it is correctly identified, and it stays open this cycle — note too that he is fit and confirmed starting at centre-back, so he is a low scorer rather than a certain zero. For this matchday specifically the softer slot is arguably Minjae's, since a benched player scores nothing at all, but the only trade that addresses it fails on timing.

verdict.headline: No action.
verdict.detail: No action. The squad is at the eleven-man floor with almost no cash, every player is fit, and nothing on the board both improves the fielded eleven and fits inside the one sale the squad can make. The balance is positive and must stay that way through the lock.

sell.reason: Nothing. There is no sale that does not either drop the squad below the floor or destroy more points than it funds. Minjae is the one name a careless run might reach for and he must not be sold: at the floor his departure is a certain penalty against a coin-flip on whether he starts. The designated attacking unwind lever remains Conte, but only ever after a better attacker has actually landed, never as the first leg.
